title.narrative: Climate adaptation and strategic economic growth led by Otolaca Irrigation Group in Nueva Esperanza, Lempira, Honduras

description.narrative: Lack of access to working capital or direct avenues to market, as well as intermediaries that pay low prices for crops, often push Honduran farmers to seek employment outside of their communities. The IAF supports community-led solutions to expand economic opportunities. Our grantee Mesa Consultativa Nueva Esperanza, La Campa, Lempira (MECONECAL) will support farmers of the Otolaca Irrigation Group to install covered production structures and adopt sustainable agriculture practices to grow vegetables for markets outside of their local area. Farmers will maximize an existing irrigation structure and collaborate to organize production around market demand. These efforts will improve farmers? incomes in Nueva Esperanza. This grant is part of the IAF's efforts to address the root causes of irregular migration in Central America.
